Fixed the hang by making `recv_ref` check whether the channel is closed when a receiver has caught up to the tail, returning `Closed` instead of waiting indefinitely. This also fixes repeated `recv`/`try_recv` calls after closure and removes an early `Empty` return that bypassed the closed check.

Updated `tokio/src/sync/broadcast.rs:761`. All 25 `sync_broadcast` tests pass, including `resubscribe_to_closed_channel`.
